How often the chart samples and redraws. Intermediate frames are averaged.
Localization.URL to open when key is pressed while co: URL to open when key is pressed while connected.
Localization.URL to open when key is pressed while se: URL to open when key is pressed while service is offline.
Localization.Day-based windows only: usage left, then: Day-based windows only: usage left, then time left in the window.
Localization.Label: Label
Localization.Leave blank to open the provider's defau: Leave blank to open the provider's default usage page.
Localization.Usage refreshes automatically. Press to: Usage refreshes automatically. Press to open the page and refresh.
Localization.All agents sums the sessions of every ag: All agents sums the sessions of every agent-berth provider.
Localization.Leave blank to only refresh the counts o: Leave blank to only refresh the counts on press.
Localization.Sessions come from agent-berth and refre: Sessions come from agent-berth and refresh every two seconds.
Localization.Leave blank to auto-detect SoundSwitch.C: Leave blank to auto-detect SoundSwitch.CLI.exe in PATH or the scoop apps directory.
Localization.Press to switch to the next playback dev: Press to switch to the next playback device. The key shows the current default output.
Localization.Press to switch to the next recording de: Press to switch to the next recording device. The key shows the current default input.
Localization.Press to toggle the default microphone m: Press to toggle the default microphone mute. The key shows LIVE or MUTED.
Localization.Press to activate the profile. The key m: Press to activate the profile. The key marks it ACTIVE while it is the active SoundSwitch profile.
Shows a shorter name on every Sound key. The list is shared by all SoundSwitch actions, so devices are renamed once.
